cases.title: Immutable capture inputs
cases.expected: Read only exact scoped captured bytes; verify ranges/file hashes; working tree modification cannot change analysis input.

cases.title: Parser provenance and isolation
cases.expected: Exact trusted package/helper/options pin, license receipt; scanned node_modules/hooks/config never execute.

cases.title: JS/TS/JSX/TSX AST support
cases.expected: Real AST extractor accounts for declarations/imports/re-exports; syntax error yields file fallback and no provisional exact edges.

cases.title: UTF16 to raw UTF8 evidence
cases.expected: BOM/CRLF/RU/astral/escaped literal boundaries and source slice hashes exact; symbols point into preserved raw bytes.

cases.title: Static literal source refs
cases.expected: Default/named/side-effect/namespace/re-export references resolve only exact eligible manifest source paths with supported policy.

cases.title: Type and symbol uncertainty
cases.expected: TYPE_ONLY edges separate from runtime SCC; imported/exported symbol binding NOT_TYPECHECKED; no false callable claim.

cases.title: TS compiler-mode gaps
cases.expected: TS .js/.mjs/.cjs imports unresolved even with exact file present; do not choose .ts/.d.ts without qualified mode.

cases.title: Unresolved dynamic/CommonJS/config forms
cases.expected: 100% known dynamic unresolved; CJS/shadowed require, aliases/workspaces and unsupported forms never guessed exact.

cases.title: Scope/missing/eligibility coverage
cases.expected: Scope escape/case mismatch/missing or ineligible targets explicit; every relevant file has analysis outcome, pending prevents readiness.

cases.title: Fake syntax and parser recovery
cases.expected: Comments/string literals containing import text create no AST refs; recovered parse diagnostics mark parser_failed.

cases.title: Deterministic IDs/digests/invalidation
cases.expected: Same input/options repeat digest; shuffled enumeration irrelevant; unrelated file preserves logical IDs; interpretation/target changes revise outputs.

cases.title: Budgets/lifecycle/cancel
cases.expected: Input/output/stderr/memory measurement/deadlines enforced; timeout stops child; per-file fallback vs global abort distinct; no leaked worker.

cases.title: Atomic derived publication
cases.expected: Crash/disk-full/cancel before commit leaves no complete derived directory and preserves previous bundle/raw ledger; corrupted reuse rejected.

cases.title: LX4-03 actual extractor metrics
cases.expected: Run 200 labelled variants with real adapter; >=98% supported precision, all dynamic unresolved; recall/20 families/holdout/zero-denominator reported.

cases.title: PR005/006/003 semantic integration
cases.expected: Actual eligibility+group schemas received/versioned; type-only/unresolved omitted from runtime SCC; raw export hashes/IDs unaffected; do not PASS without artifacts.

cases.title: Windows/offline resource evidence
cases.expected: Actual parser offline load and parent/child RSS on Dell-class Windows; source LX4-06 recorded separately, unavailable device cases NOT_RUN.
